name.description: Dotted path to the offending field

type.description: URI reference identifying the problem type. `about:blank` when the status code says everything.

title.description: Short summary, stable per problem type

instance.description: URI reference of the specific occurrence — the request path

correlationId.description: Correlation id of the request, for log lookups

email.description: Read-only here — changing it is an admin operation.

twoFactorEnabled.description: Always false: two-factor authentication is not enabled on this deployment. Present so a client can render the control without probing for the field.

current.description: True for the session this request was made with.

updatedAt.description: Last time the session was seen.

total.description: Total matching records, across all pages.

permissions.description: CASL permission rules the caller effectively holds.

sensitive.description: Flagged in the role builder. Not treated differently at request time.

fields.description: Attributes that may be granted or denied individually.

scopes.description: Scope dimensions this resource can be narrowed by.

credentialScope.description: Credential-scope group, when the resource is reachable by API tokens.

grantable.description: Rules the caller may put on a role. Anything outside this list is rejected, so the role builder can disable it up front.

resourceId.description: Null grants every resource of that type within the organization.

grantedScopes.description: Scopes the credential carries. Null for a browser session, which is not scope-restricted.

effectiveScopes.description: What the credential can actually do: its scopes intersected with the owner’s current roles.

organizationIds.description: Organizations the credential is restricted to, or null when unrestricted.

prefix.description: Non-secret display prefix. The secret itself is shown only once, at creation.

organizationIds.description: Organizations this token is restricted to. Null means it follows the owner’s memberships.

ipAllowlist.description: Source addresses or CIDR blocks the token may be used from.

policies.description: Empty when the level governs the caller’s own account only.

sensitive.description: Grants account-takeover-adjacent powers. Consent and token screens call these out; enforcement treats them like any other group.

groups.description: Every permission group, each with a Read and an Edit level. Render these as the permission picker.

grantable.description: Scopes the caller may put on a token. Anything outside this list is refused at creation.

prefix.description: Non-secret display prefix. The secret itself is shown only once, at creation.

organizationIds.description: Organizations this token is restricted to. Null means it follows the owner’s memberships.

ipAllowlist.description: Source addresses or CIDR blocks the token may be used from.

token.description: The token secret. Shown once — store it now, it cannot be retrieved again.

isSystem.description: System roles cannot be deleted or renamed.

organizationId.description: Owning organization, or null for a global role template shared by every tenant.

permissions.description: CASL permission rules granted by this role.

available.description: True when the slug is available.

teams.description: Workspaces (Better Auth teams) in this organization.

id.description: The control-plane id. Everything but the connect body uses this.

accountLogin.description: The account the App is installed on.

repositorySelection.description: What the installation dialog granted. GitHub enforces it, not us.

suspendedAt.description: Set while GitHub reports the installation suspended; nothing resolves until it clears.

defaultBranch.description: Offered as the default base branch.

archived.description: Archived on GitHub: readable, but pushes are refused.

pushedAt.description: When GitHub last saw a push, for ordering the picker.

protected.description: Whether a branch protection rule applies.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the repository’s default branch.

ownerUserId.description: The person who paired this machine. A host has no workspace.

capabilities.description: What the runner last reported: the tools it found and their versions, the agents on PATH, free disk. A hint for the UI, never a gate — a session opens on a machine without the agent installed.

publicKeyFingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the host’s Ed25519 public key, hex. The key itself stays server-side.

online.description: Whether the runner has sent a heartbeat recently enough to be considered attached. Derived on read, never stored.

unpairedAt.description: When the host was unpaired. The row is kept so its history survives.

name.description: The name the machine will adopt when it registers with this token.

prefix.description: Non-secret display prefix. The secret is shown once, in the install command.

createdFromIp.description: Where the token was minted from. Behind a proxy this is the real client only once TRUST_PROXY names the hop count.

redeemedFromIp.description: Where it was spent from — a different fact from where it was minted.

name.description: The name the machine will adopt when it registers with this token.

prefix.description: Non-secret display prefix. The secret is shown once, in the install command.

createdFromIp.description: Where the token was minted from. Behind a proxy this is the real client only once TRUST_PROXY names the hop count.

redeemedFromIp.description: Where it was spent from — a different fact from where it was minted.

installCommand.description: The one-line command that installs and registers the runner on the machine.

installScriptSha256.description: SHA-256 of the installer the command downloads, hex, for anyone who reads the script before running it. Null when the deployment did not publish one.

agentPrompt.description: The same instruction phrased for a coding agent already running on the machine, for someone who would rather paste it there.

hostId.description: The host this machine now is.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of the control plane’s Ed25519 public key, hex. The runner pins it.

channel.description: The release channel this host follows.

releaseBaseUrl.description: Where the runner fetches signed release artifacts from.

version.description: Changes whenever any flag or segment configuration does.

flags.description: Every client flag, keyed by name.

usedBy.description: Flags whose rules target this segment.

weight.description: Percentage of the audience, 0–100. The arms sum to 100.

value.description: Serve one value to everyone reached.

split.description: Split the audience between values by a deterministic hash.

enabled.description: The master switch. Off serves the default to everyone.

fallthrough.description: Served when enabled and no rule matched.

variants.description: The values a variant flag takes; empty for a boolean flag.

defaultValue.description: The safe value, served when nothing else decides.

expired.description: A temporary flag past its expiry date: remove it from the code.

config.description: Null until targeting is first saved; the flag serves its default.

ruleId.description: The rule that decided, when one did.

name.description: The GitHub repository’s name, as GitHub spells it. Display only.

slug.description: The project’s directory name on every host that holds it. Immutable, and derived from the repository: `<repo>`, or `<owner>--<repo>` when another repository already holds that name.

originGithubRepoId.description: GitHub’s id for the repository whose first session created the project, as a string because the column is a bigint.

model.description: The model the agent was launched with; null runs that agent’s own default.

permission.description: What the agent may do on the host without asking. `full` is the one level that changes a machine unattended, and is never a remembered default. Null for an agent with no approvals (the blank terminal).

effort.description: How hard the agent may think. Null leaves the agent its own default.

installationId.description: The GitHub installation this repository’s tokens are minted through.

githubRepoId.description: GitHub’s repository id, as a string because the column is a bigint.

repositoryFullName.description: A display snapshot of `owner/repo`, refreshed whenever a checkout is created.

directoryName.description: The directory inside the session. Never reused, even after removal.

storeDirectoryName.description: What the runner named the bare store under `repos/`. Null until it reports.

mode.description: Recorded rather than guessed: cleanup differs between the two.

baseBranch.description: What the session’s branch was created from.

branch.description: Always the session’s own branch, never the base.

name.description: Display name. It starts equal to the slug, then the first prompt names it.
name.example: Fix the wallet list empty state

slug.description: The session’s directory name and the last segment of its branch. Immutable, and never reissued.

agent.description: The coding agent this session runs.

state.description: The derived group — what the sidebar dot shows, computed from the row and organised by what needs you: the session failed, the agent has been blocked for 30 s, or a launch has sat unready for 60 s. Two arms have no writer until the relay and the pull-request flow land: `landing`, and the fourth `waiting-on-you` source (the pane is gone with no report).

lifecycle.description: The stored lifecycle: the fold of the session’s append-only log. It answers whether the work is finished, not whether a process is running — stopping a session does not move it.

cwdCheckoutId.description: Which checkout the agent was launched inside. Null starts it in the session directory with every checkout a peer.

stoppedAt.description: When the agent and the tmux session last ended. The checkouts stay on disk.

hints.description: What the control plane could not do for this request. Empty on a read; `host_offline` means the command was recorded but no link to the host exists, so the work is owed.

total.description: Total matching sessions, across all pages.

seq.description: Dense and monotonic per session. Assigned by the control plane, never on the wire.

kind.description: What happened. Free-form on purpose: a runner newer than this control plane may log a kind it has never heard of, and the log keeps it.

payload.description: At most 8 KB, and never pane text: PTY bytes go to the browser and the runner’s ring buffer, never to Postgres.

nextSeq.description: Pass as `afterSeq` to read on, or null at the end of the log.

ticket.description: Single-use, 60 seconds. Present it in `Sec-WebSocket-Protocol` when opening the relay socket — never in the URL.

url.description: The path to open the WebSocket on, on this API’s own origin.

window.description: The tmux window this ticket authorises. Tabs are tmux windows.

github_app.description: The sessions GitHub App is configured.

github_app_install_url.description: Where Connect GitHub sends the browser, built from the App's slug. `null` when no App is configured — a console must not offer an install page that does not exist. Served here so the browser needs no copy of the slug.
